sloka: वाली नाम मम भ्राता ज्येष्ठः शत्रु निषूदनः ।पितुः बहुमतः नित्यम् मम च अपि तथा पुरा ॥४-९-१॥
transliteration: vālī nāma mama bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ śatru niṣūdanaḥ ।pituḥ bahumataḥ nityam mama ca api tathā purā ॥4-9-1॥

translations.english: 'My elder brother called Vali, capable of exterminating enemies was always highly regarded by my father and me.
